summary.fr: Fondateur du « nouveau Nyāya » (Navya-Nyāya), auteur du <w>Tattvacintāmaṇi</w>, dont la langue technique devient celle de toute la scolastique indienne.
summary.en: Founder of "new Nyāya" (Navya-Nyāya), author of the <w>Tattvacintāmaṇi</w>, whose technical language became that of all Indian scholasticism.
